review_scope: Identifier coverage and byte custody only; no case-text review, design-hypothesis review, semantic adjudication, provider execution, or source edits.

identifier_contract.cases: cases[*].slot must equal frozen spec data.partition.slots in order (materializer line 134).
identifier_contract.design_entries: set(design_entries[*].slot) must equal set(data.partition.slots) (lines 135-136); duplicates also independently counted.
identifier_contract.relations: set(relations[*].id) must equal set(data.partition.relation_slots) (lines 137-138); no inferred renaming or mapping.

selection.rule: Earliest complete PASS_REQUEST_PATH_ONLY attempt per frozen author partition, sorted by receipt started_at_utc then finished_at_utc then directory; completeness means receipt, raw response, response text, and parsed output files exist; no identifier or semantic quality selection.
